# fabric_sites (Data Source)

Decode FABRIC advertised resources into typed site capacity, host, and component data. This data source reads advertised resources at detail level `2` and converts the graph into Terraform attributes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    fabric = {
      source  = "Testbed-IAC/fabric"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "fabric_token" {
  description = "FABRIC ID token (JWT). Set via TF_VAR_fabric_token. Do not commit."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

provider "fabric" {
  token = var.fabric_token
}

# Decode advertised resources into typed site capacity, host, and component data.
# Omit includes/excludes to return every site your allocation can see.
data "fabric_sites" "all" {}

# Site names available to your allocation, for use as var.site elsewhere.
output "site_names" {
  value = [for site in data.fabric_sites.all.sites : site.name]
}

# Available GPU counts per site, keyed by component name (e.g. GPU/RTX6000).
output "gpu_availability" {
  value = {
    for site in data.fabric_sites.all.sites : site.name => {
      for component in site.components : component.name => component.available
      if startswith(component.name, "GPU/")
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `excludes` (String) Comma-separated site codes to exclude, such as `RENC,UKY`.
- `force_refresh` (Boolean) Whether to bypass cached resource information. Defaults to `false`.
- `includes` (String) Comma-separated site codes to include, such as `RENC,UKY`.
- `name` (String) Optional exact site name filter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic data source identifier assigned by the provider.
- `sites` (Attributes List) Typed FABRIC site resource data assigned by the provider after decoding advertised resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites))

<a id="nestedatt--sites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sites`

Read-Only:

- `components` (Attributes List) Component availability data assigned by FABRIC advertised resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites--components))
- `cores` (Attributes) CPU core capacity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites--cores))
- `disk` (Attributes) Disk capacity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites--disk))
- `hosts` (Attributes List) Host-level resource data for this site assigned by FABRIC advertised resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites--hosts))
- `ipv4_management` (Boolean) Whether the site advertises IPv4 management support. Assigned by FABRIC advertised resources.
- `name` (String) Site name assigned by FABRIC.
- `ptp` (Boolean) Whether the site advertises PTP support. Assigned by FABRIC advertised resources.
- `ram` (Attributes) RAM capacity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites--ram))

<a id="nestedatt--sites--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sites.components`

Read-Only:

- `allocated` (Number) Currently allocated component count assigned by FABRIC.
- `available` (Number) Currently available component count assigned by FABRIC.
- `capacity` (Number) Total advertised component count assigned by FABRIC.
- `name` (String) Component key assigned by FABRIC, such as `GPU/A30` or `SmartNIC/ConnectX-6`.
